name: Containerlab
description: CLI for orchestrating and managing container-based networking labs. Starts containers, builds virtual wiring between them to create lab topologies, and manages lab lifecycle. Supports 40+ NOS kinds including Nokia SR Linux, Arista cEOS, Cisco XRd, Juniper cRPD, SONiC, and VM-based routers via vrnetlab.

docker_support.docker_evidence: No software apart from Docker is required. Single-binary packaging with code-based lab definition files.

eval_notes: Leading network lab tool - ideal for building agentic evaluation environments with realistic multi-vendor topologies. Supports rootless operation, VSCode extension, packet capture, and topology graph export. Replaces docker-compose for network lab scenarios. Essential lab orchestration tool for network telemetry evaluations. Creates realistic multi-vendor topologies with telemetry integration for CI/CD testing. Premier container-based network lab orchestrator. Supports 30+ network OS kinds (Nokia SR Linux, Arista cEOS, Cisco XRd, FRR, SONiC, VyOS). Infrastructure-as-code topology definitions (.clab files) make it perfect for automated agentic evaluations. De facto standard for Docker-based network labs. Generates Ansible and Nornir inventory files automatically. Supports NETCONF on Nokia SR Linux (port 830), Juniper cRPD, Arista cEOS, Cisco XRd, and Nokia SR OS. The 'clab-topo' GitHub topic provides a distributed catalog of community labs. The best lab orchestrator for multi-device NETCONF topologies. Agents can interact with complex network topologies where each node has NETCONF enabled. Ideal for end-to-end agentic config management evals. 2500+ stars. De-facto standard for container-based network labs. Developed by Nokia/srl-labs. De facto standard for container-based network labs. Infrastructure-as-Code topology definitions in YAML. Supports both native containers and VM-based NOS via vrnetlab integration.
